title: Boundary wall maximum length, R50 and above (14 m then 3 m setback)
text: C3.4.4 Boundary walls may be built in accordance with Table 3.4c provided: i. boundary walls are located behind the street setback; ii. overshadowing does not exceed the limits of C3.8.1; and iii. they are finished to an equivalent standard to the rest of the development, to the satisfaction of the decision-maker. Table 3.4c Lot boundary setbacks, R50 and above, maximum boundary wall length: where frontage is 8.5m or less, 14m length, at which point the wall is to be set back a minimum of 3m measured from the lot boundary for a minimum length of 3m; where frontage is greater than 8.5m, the same, with a cumulative maximum of 65% of the lot boundary the wall abuts. Number of boundaries All.

parts.label: portion beyond 14 m set back 3 m for at least 3 m

exceptions.label: abuts an existing or simultaneously constructed wall of similar or greater dimension (C3.4.5)

replaces.note: 14 m then 3 m setback for a minimum 3 m length (C4P1-095)

notes: from: ch3 C3.4.4#length-r50. Table 3.4c (p34) values unchanged from Chapter 3; the clause text now cites C3.8.1 for overshadowing. Applies to every R50-R60 lot; lots wider than 8.5 m must also meet C3.4.4#length-r50-wide. Overlaps C3.4.2 (14 m upper-storey wall rule).
